lobal Futures Scholarship Details

University Of Manchester in the United Kingdom (UK) is accepting applications for the 2026 Global Futures Scholarships from international students.

The scholarship, open to both undergraduate and master’s students, has a total value of over £4.5 million and will be awarded for a consecutive period of three years.

The University of Manchester is a public research university in Manchester, England, formed in 2004 by the merger of the University of Manchester Institute of Science and Technology and the Victoria University of Manchester. 

Through their unique combination of disciplines and specialist expertise, global future scholars are positioned to influence the grand challenges of this century, notably poverty eradication, securing social justice, environmental change, and sustainable urbanism


2026 University Of Manchester Global Futures Scholarship Benefits

Undergraduate awards

    The University of Manchester is proud to offer more than 100 merit-based undergraduate scholarships of up to £30,000.
    The award is valued at £10,000 per year over three years to international students from a selection of countries across the globe, conditional on attainment of 60% average in each year. Scholarships will be awarded in the form of a discount on published overseas tuition fees. 

Master’s awards 

    The University of Manchester is proud to offer more than 230 merit-based master’s scholarships to prospective international students from a range of countries across the globe. 
    These scholarships of £18,000 will be awarded based on academic excellence and the quality of your responses in the online application form. 
    Scholarships will be awarded in the form of a discount on published overseas tuition fees. 

PhD Scholarships

    For PhDs, the University offers a number of competitive bursaries via individual Schools and research groups for well-qualified candidates.
    Please check with your prospective academic School for detail,s and check the University’s postgraduate research


2026 University Of Manchester Global Futures Scholarship Requirements

To be eligible for the undergraduate and postgraduate 2026 University Of Manchester Global Futures Scholarship, applicants must satisfy the following conditions:Scholarship eligibility checker

Applications will be considered from international fee-paying students domiciled in the following countries: Nigeria, Kenya, Ghana, Egypt, Botswana, Tanzania, Zimbabwe, and South Africa.

    To be considered as domiciled in these countries, applicants must have predominantly resided there during the last three years.
    Applicants must be self-funded (not sponsored).
    Applicants for Medicine (MBChB), Dentistry (BDS), Architecture, or any courses with an integrated foundation year are not eligible for the award.
    Applicants must have selected The University of Manchester as their FIRM UCAS choice by 23 May 2026.
    Applicants who have previously studied in the UK are not eligible for the award.
    The award applies only to full-time courses of study delivered at The University of Manchester’s UK campus in Manchester. Applicants for blended and distance learning programmes are not eligible for the award.
    Undergraduate applicants must be applying for direct first-year entry in 2026 and have, or be working towards one of the following qualifications:
    Study abroad programs

        A-levels
        IB Diploma
        South African NSC or IEB
        NCUK International Foundation Year
    Applicants who have previously studied at a higher  education institution in the UK are not eligible for the award.

For Postgraduate 

    Applicants for the African awards must hold an unconditional offer to study a full-time on-campus master’s course at The University of Manchester for a course starting in September 2025 by 23 April 2026.
    Applicants must submit an online scholarship application form by the same deadline. The application form will be emailed to all eligible offer-holders.
    Applicants for MBA, MPhil, Master of Architecture (MArch), Architecture and Urbanism (MA), Master of Landscape Architecture (MLA), Postgraduate Certificate in  Education (PGCE), Clinical Medicine and Dentistry degrees are not eligible for the award.
